sentences.text: At the end of 1953, French troops were based in the Điện Biên Phủ valley, a basin among the mountains of the north-west.
The Vietnamese side had to bring soldiers, food and weapons there along long, steep mountain routes.
Soldiers opened roads, and a great many porters carried loads or pushed bicycles loaded with food and ammunition along tracks that enemy aircraft tried to attack.
At first, the command planned a quick attack and had pulled the guns into position.
But at the end of January 1954 the enemy force in the valley grew stronger, and the command decided to change to a steadier approach: to strike only when sure of success.
The guns were pulled back out, and the preparations began again.
This was hard, costly work, but it meant the battle was prepared more carefully.
